notes: «وَ غَيْرِهِ» («and others») is an unnamed co-transmitter at the same level as Muhammad b. Jumhur.

«قال سمعته يقول»: Abu Abdullah says he heard someone speak; the speaker he heard is not named in the text. needs_ruling: whether the chain ends at Abu Abdullah or runs on through an unnamed hearer is not settled by the text (rule 8 forbids filling it).
«عليه السلام» and «عليه السلام» (the Qa'im) are honorifics, left out.
